decisive_items: HEV IgG and IgM were positive but HEV RNA was undetectable
She denied use of herbal or alternative medicines
ANA, antimitochondrial antibody, antismooth muscle antibody, P-ANCA, C-ANCA, and anti–liver-kidney microsomal type 1 antibody were negative
response.rationale: Positive HEV IgM/IgG fits an acute HEV infection as the most specific cause of this acute hepatitis/ALF; negative HEV RNA can occur late in the course. Alternative causes are excluded by normal ceruloplasmin and alpha-1 antitrypsin, negative autoimmune antibodies, and denied toxin exposure.

rejected.why: Non-specific; HEV-specific serology makes hepatitis E the more precise viral diagnosis.
No hepatotoxin exposure; herbal/alternative medicine use was denied.
Only ferritin elevation is present; lacks required features of HLH such as cytopenias, fever, splenomegaly.
Autoantibody panel is negative, and positive HEV serology provides a more likely alternative cause.
Normal ceruloplasmin and lack of Wilson-specific features make Wilson's disease unlikely.
